subject: Request: short-term access sponsorship while PO clears
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Grant <elliot@huxley.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: short-term access sponsorship while PO clears

Hi Elliot —

Thanks for the update earlier. I understand your procurement team is still routing the PO and that the expected clear date slipped — totally understandable. We want to keep your engineering team running so they can finish the integration tests they mentioned.

Quick ask: would Huxley be open to a short-term sponsored credit we can provision today to keep the sandbox and CI flows live for up to 10 days while the PO clears? No changes to the contract: this would be a temporary credit with simple terms (we'll attach the short terms).

If that's acceptable I can route this for approval internally and provision the credits to the account tied to deal HV-3921. If you can confirm who from procurement we should keep in the loop (and whether a proof-of-funds screenshot is useful), we’ll include that when we provision.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm procurement contact and any inbound timing constraints.
- We provision a capped credit (suggested: $2,000 sandbox credit) and send terms.
- Procurement finalizes PO; credits are non-recurring and expire once PO is complete.

Thanks — want to avoid your team hitting a hard stop on the integration.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0194

Subject: Re: Request: short-term access sponsorship while PO clears

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the quick reach.

Yes, procurement is the holdup. We’ve got internal approvals but the vendor intake queue pushed our PO to next week. I looped in procurement above. Our legal/compliance team also asked for a short statement showing there’s no billing change before PO settlement, and a brief confirmation that the credit is one-off.

A $2,000 sandbox credit sounds about right. Procurement’s main ask is a record showing the terms and an approximate expiry date for the temporary credit. If you can provide a one-page terms PDF and note the expiry window, procurement can sign off quickly.

Elliot
Head of Product | Huxley Labs
elliot@huxley.ai

- Billing: No automatic billing or subscription changes; standard billing resumes once PO is processed.
- Proof: We can accept a screenshot or email from procurement indicating PO in process; optional.

If procurement needs a proof-of-funds snapshot, attach that and we’ll note it on the credit memo.

Ben — are you ok to provision pending Dylan’s approval? I will attach the credit memo and terms to the HubSpot deal.
